modal_desc: Select your Solana wallet to sign in securely with Sign-In With Solana (SIWS).
deep_link_caption: Or open this page inside your wallet app and sign in from there:
no_wallet_mobile: No Solana wallet found in this browser. Open this page from inside your wallet app's built-in browser to sign in.
no_wallet_desktop: No Solana wallet detected. Install one and refresh the page.
mwa_hint: Opens Phantom, Solflare or Seed Vault
err_sign: Message signing was cancelled or failed.
err_connect: Could not connect to {{ wallet }}. Please make sure it is installed.
tx_internal: Transaction failed (Internal error). Check that your wallet is on the app's network (for example Devnet) and has enough SOL for fees.
tx_rejected: You cancelled the transaction. Tap the button to try again when ready.
tx_insufficient: Insufficient balance. Make sure you have enough SOL for fees and USDC for the deposit.
tx_sim_tokens: Transaction simulation failed. You may not have enough tokens for this transaction.
tx_sim_retry: Transaction simulation failed. This may be temporary — please try again in a few seconds.
tx_network: Network issue. Your transaction may still be processing. Check your wallet history before retrying.
tx_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
cluster_mismatch: Wallet is on {wallet_cluster} but the app expects {expected}. Switch your wallet network to {expected} and try again.
